integrity.reproducibility: Two standalone algorithms independently enumerate states and legal moves and compare distances in bounded ranges. The all-order result is proved mathematically.

scientific_limitations: This theorem concerns unlabeled independent sets containing exactly m-1 vertices on a uniform depth-two m-arm spider with m >= 3; it does not claim general shortest-path algorithms for spiders, other token layers, or all trees. Computation verifies only finite m; infinity is covered by explicit proof.
title: A cubical complete-graph bridge geometry for token sliding on subdivided stars
